import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 5000010;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static int n, m, k, v1, v2, s, t;
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAXN];
    static List<Edge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int edgeCount;
    
    static class Edge {
        int to, next, v, cost;
        public Edge(int to, int next, int v, int cost) {
            this.to = to;
            this.next = next;
            this.v = v;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }
    
    static void addEdge(int from, int to, int val, int cost) {
        edges.add(new Edge(to, head[from], val, cost));
        head[from] = edges.size() - 1;
        edges.add(new Edge(from, head[to], 0, -cost));
        head[to] = edges.size() - 1;
    }
    
    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        Arrays.fill(visited, false);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        dist[s] = 0;
        visited[s] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            visited[x] = false;
            for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                int y = e.to, c = e.cost;
                if (dist[y] <= dist[x] + c || e.v == 0) continue;
                dist[y] = dist[x] + c;
                if (!visited[y]) {
                    visited[y] = true;
                    q.offer(y);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != INF;
    }
    
    static int dfs(int x, int limit) {
        if (x == t) return limit;
        visited[x] = true;
        int res = limit;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != -1; i = edges.get(i).next) {
            Edge e = edges.get(i);
            int y = e.to, v = e.v;
            if (dist[y] != dist[x] + e.cost || v == 0 || visited[y]) continue;
            int flow = dfs(y, Math.min(res, v));
            if (flow > 0) {
                e.v -= flow;
                edges.get(i ^ 1).v += flow;
                res -= flow;
                if (res == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return limit - res;
    }
    
    static int maxFlow() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int flow;
            while ((flow = dfs(s, INF)) > 0) {
                totalFlow += flow * dist[t];
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }
    
    static int IDX(int x, int k) {
        return x + (k - 1) * n;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v1 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        v2 = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = 0;
        t = IDX(n, 110) + 1;
        Arrays.fill(head, -1);
        for (int i = 2; i <= 110; ++i) {
            addEdge(IDX(1, i), t, INF, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                addEdge(IDX(i, j), IDX(i, j + 1), INF, v1);
            }
        }
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int[] xArr = new int[k];
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            xArr[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            addEdge(s, IDX(xArr[i], 1), 1, 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 1; j < 110; ++j) {
                addEdge(IDX(x, j), IDX(y, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * j - 1) + v1);
                addEdge(IDX(y, j), IDX(x, j + 1), 1, v2 * (2 * j - 1) + v1);
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
